## Summary

What capability should be added?

## Motivation

Why is this useful for QMC.jl users or maintainers?

## Proposed design

Describe the API, component family, and any expected interaction with existing generators, measures, integrands, stopping criteria, or kernels.

## QMCPy relationship

Is this strict parity, approximate parity, aspirational parity, or a Julia-only extension?

## Validation plan

What tests, demos, docs, or benchmarks should accompany this change?
